in_marathi.name: Kapil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Black-haired, dark complexioned
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kapil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kapi', meaning 'hair' or 'black'. Kapil is a name of Lord Shiva, who is depicted as having dark, matted hair.
